entities.title: Idle exit period
entities.summary: How long the daemon keeps running with no clients before it exits.
entities.type: number of minutes (environment variable, fractions allowed)
entities.scope: the daemon process; read from the environment of the process that starts it
entities.validation: Parsed with double.Parse; a value that does not parse stops the daemon command with an exception.
entities.details: Read in src/Program.cs when the daemon command starts and passed to DaemonServer as idleExit.
